messages.subject: Minimum Column Width - Overlapping Elements
parts:
I have a two column layout with an image in the left column that is 550px wide and a datatable element in the right column.  If the browser is too narrow, rather than knocking the datatable underneath the image, they overlap each other.  Eventually, if the browser is too narrow, it puts the datatable below the image, but I would like to know if there is a way to make sure that the two elements never overlap.  Here's some sample code from my ui.R.  Any help is appreciated.  Thanks!

fluidRow(
column(width=5,
     plotOutput("mainplot", height="600px", width="600px")
      
        ),
column(width=7,
 DT::dataTableOutput("dtelement")

  )
)
)
